description: This Java source file defines the BlogRssServices class which provides methods for generating RSS feeds for blog content within the OFBiz framework. It includes methods to assemble RSS feed data, retrieve related content, and format it into syndication entries.

classes.name: BlogRssServices
classes.description: Utility class providing services related to generating RSS feeds for blog content within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: generateBlogRssFeed
methods.description: Generates an RSS feed for a specified blog content, assembling the feed with entries related to the blog post identified by blogContentId.

methods.name: generateEntryList
methods.description: Retrieves and constructs a list of syndication entries (RSS items) related to the specified blog content, including associated sub-content rendered as text.
